name: app-real-estate-app-long-case-study-with-problem-circles-and-handshake
title: Real Estate Case Study with Overlapping Circles
whatItIs: A very tall white page with a Problem & Solution heading, two overlapping circles (black for problem, white for solution) with red and green dots, a full-width handshake and house model photo, a hand-held app, social media posts and a red For Sale sign photo.
whatItMeans: The dark and light circles show the contrast between problem and solution at a glance, and full-width photos add human context.
techniques: Overlapping black and white circles as a diagram
Coloured dot markers linked by thin lines
Phone in hand on grey ground
Social post mockups as a touchpoint

vocabulary.definition: Circles intersecting to show contrast or relation.
A full-width photograph separating text sections.
A small coloured dot signalling a label.
